Subject: Follow-up: POC plan and success criteria (next steps)

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for your time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment for the 3-week POC: 

POC scope (confirmed):
- Endpoint: Text generation + retrieval-augmented generation on your internal knowledge base (sales enablement docs)
- Data: customer-facing docs and a snapshot of the CRM exported to S3

Success criteria (you confirmed with the product team):
1) Precision: >= 85% accuracy on a held-out set of 50 representative Q&A prompts (manual eval)
2) Latency: 95th percentile end-to-end under 400ms for single-turn queries in your staging region
3) Cost: token cost not exceeding $X per 1k queries at test throughput (we'll provide approximations)
4) Ops: infra readiness (VPC peering + S3 read access)

Evaluation plan & timeline:
- Week 0 (this week): infra access, data handoff, and baseline run (Marissa / Rishi own)
- Week 1: model tuning and initial qualitative evals (Connor / Rishi)
- Week 2: scale tests, latency tuning, and cost estimates (Connor)
- Week 3: final evaluation, handoff and go/no-go (Alex + Product)

Ownerships / immediate asks:
- Alex: confirm the 50-sample eval set by Wed (3/4) and share via the Drive link
- Priya: confirm S3 credentials or short-term token to Rishi (rishi@redwood.ai) and the network contact for peering
- Connor: will schedule a 30-min infra kickoff with your infra team (proposed Mon 3/2)

Attachments: I'm including a starter success-criteria spreadsheet and a short network requirements PDF.

If that looks correct, we'll kick off the infra work tomorrow. Happy to update timelines if we need to shift.

Best,
Marissa Cole
